_comment: Weights for Tools/_SW/ci_shard.py, in seconds of CI run time (2-core, 8 GB private-repo runner). Classes not listed weigh seconds_per_test per [Test]/[TestCase] plus seconds_per_case_source per [TestCaseSource]. Calibrated 2026-11-04 from run 41827585917 (PostMapInitTest alone 6.5 min, GlobalWarEconomyLongRunTest alone 8.5 min, GlobalWarRespawnTest shard 2.3 min, 176 small tests 7.5 min) and a local TRX of the GlobalWar classes times 2.2 (CI/local ratio of the same shard). The CI log prints every test with its time; refine from it. Classes in 'heavy' go to different shards first; a heavy split class makes each listed method heavy. 'split' packs a class per method (seconds per method): EntityTest alone ran past the 20-minute watchdog in run 41849018067 (four methods 1-2 min each, then SpawnAndDirtyAllEntities still running at 20 min; alone locally it takes 1 m 53 s, so about 4-5 min on CI), and next to GlobalWar classes its spawn-all tests ran the runner out of memory (run 41839146549).
